collision_result: ASVB cannot claim novelty for actor tokens, attenuation, sender-constraining, audience restriction or structured authorization. Its only surviving project-specific hypothesis is semantic voice separation across Frank token ingress and DE_TO_CLAY/ClayCode cognition: authenticated origin voice, relay-actor voice and transport metadata remain distinct while standard authorization supplies the credential/delegation substrate.
